Description

Study the South Atlantic Anomaly. This includes electron, proton, and trace gas composition, along with temperature, density, and energy spectra of the plasma.

Notes

Was in ESA Fly your satellite but did not make to second round. Also second in Canadian Satellite Design Challenge. Raised 15000 from Kickstarter. No news for years.
